candidates.reason: SEL designs and manufactures digital protection, automation and control equipment. Its captured About page identifies Pullman headquarters and US manufacturing since 1984. Captured support materials establish product-security assessment, code review and testing, continuing security updates and application engineering support. Clearwater models a bounded US sustaining-firmware and product-assurance unit within an established protective-relay manufacturer. It maintains shipped firmware, investigates defects, reviews remedies and prepares guidance for customers operating installed equipment. Synthetic scale: 24 employees support four relay families, twelve maintained firmware branches, approximately 180 US customer organizations and 14,000 registered devices. Ordinary monthly work includes 45 firmware/application support cases, eight escalated engineering investigations, three security assessments and two maintenance-candidate reviews; these categories overlap. A ten-year archive contains release notes, compatibility decisions, completed test reports and customer cases. The six listed workers are recurring decision participants, not the whole workforce. Their outputs include source analyses, verification assessments, remediation priorities, maintenance commitments and internally approved customer guidance. Manufacturing, laboratory execution, firmware signing and customer installation remain outside the selected digital cycles.
